test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Anita Sharma, Sangeet Natak Akademi Award winner, is an exponent of _______ dance form.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sattriya**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Anita Sharma is a renowned exponent of the **Sattriya dance form**, which is one of the eight classical dance forms of India.
 
• Sattriya originated in the state of **Assam** and was introduced by the Vaishnavite saint **Sankardev** in the 15th century.
 
• This dance form is traditionally performed in **Sattras (monasteries)** as a part of the devotional services.
 
• Anita Sharma has significantly contributed to the **promotion and preservation** of Sattriya through her performances and teachings.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Odissi:**

 
 
• It is one of the oldest classical dance forms of India, originating from the state of **Odisha**.
 
• Odissi is known for its **sculptural poses** and fluidity of movements.
 
• This dance form is traditionally performed to **Odia music**.
 
 
 
• **Mohiniyattam:**
 
 
• Mohiniyattam is a classical dance form from the state of **Kerala**.
 
• It is characterized by graceful, swaying body movements and is usually performed by **women**.
 
• This dance form is performed to the accompaniment of **Carnatic music**.
 
 
 
• **Kathakali:**
 
 
• Kathakali is a classical dance-drama form from **Kerala**.
 
• It is known for its elaborate costumes, intricate makeup, and **face masks**.
 
• Kathakali performances are based on themes from Hindu **epics** like the Ramayana and Mahabharata.
 
 
 
• **Sattriya:**
 
 
• Sattriya dance is a major Indian classical dance form that originated in the **Vaishnavite monasteries** of Assam.
 
• It was introduced by the Bhakti saint **Sankardev** as a medium for the propagation of the Vaishnavism.
 
• The dance form integrates **drama, dance, and music** to narrate mythological tales and is performed by male monks called **Bhakats**.
